title: Head Swap sends a box that is not the one drawn - the whole image reaches the sampler
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-560 (the Flow track). Raised by Fabio 2026-09-18 while proving MPI-532; NOT package-specific.

SYMPTOM: in the Head Swap flow the latent entering the sampler is the WHOLE target image (three people), not the head crop the user boxed. The same graph on the G:\ComfyUi bench, with a hand-set Input_Box, crops to the face correctly.

CORRECTED 2026-09-18 - THE ORIGINAL PREMISE WAS WRONG. The card was raised on "x is NEGATIVE, so the box the app sends is wrong". A negative box origin is BY DESIGN and is not evidence of anything:
- js/services/workflowInjectors/headSwapInjector.js header: x/y are TOP-LEFT in absolute SOURCE pixels and "MAY BE NEGATIVE (MPI-325)". The injector deliberately does NOT clamp - it used to, and that was removed because clamping "silently rewrites a legal negative origin to 0 and moves the box".
- Both Head Swap steps declare `overflow: 'allow'` (js/data/flowsRegistry.js:504 and :514). Node 89 Mpi Box Crop carries `pad: true` to put the overhang back.
- docs/playbooks/add-flow/ui/box-gizmo.md documents the whole contract and records it verified end to end on 2026-08-17 (MPI-325 validation.md).
- Fabio's own bench screenshot: Input_Box_2 x=-130 and the crop is correct.
ALSO NOT THE BUG: the box SIZE. Fabio confirmed (2026-09-18) he deliberately drew box1 large to take in the target's hair, with roughly half the box outside the image. The 14:21 box1 {x:-619, w:1299} on a 1664-wide image is 48% outside - exactly what he describes. So the gizmo/param capture is FAITHFUL and is no longer a suspect.

MEASURED (project "New Project", 2026-09-18):
- user:head-swap-test 14:21 - box1 {x:-619, y:556, w:1299, h:1299}, box2 {x:-183, y:185, w:1176, h:1176}; inputs 1664x2304 (image1) and 768x1344 (image2).
- flowHeadSwap (the BUILT-IN op) 11:21 - box1 {x:-245, y:594, w:1166, h:1166}, box2 {x:-201, y:173, w:1171, h:1171}. Same shape, so this is Head Swap itself, not the package loader.
- The dispatched graph (:48188/history job d89361c6) carries exactly the sidecar numbers, so the injector is faithful too.
- UNEXPLAINED, the one capture-side loose end left: the app UI showed "1290 x 1290" under the target gizmo and "1171 x 1171" under the reference one while the sidecar recorded 1299 and 1176. Close but not equal, and the two deltas are different ratios (0.7% and 0.4%), so this is probably per-zoom rounding rather than a scale error. Check it, but it is not big enough to explain the symptom.

LEADING HYPOTHESIS (2026-09-18, not yet verified) - the GRAPH inflates a heavily-overflowing box on the MASK slot:
docs/playbooks/add-flow/ui/box-gizmo.md line 85 says of the box1 consumer: "Mpi Box Mask ... is full-frame and clips at the edge ... If it feeds InpaintCropImproved, that node grows the region back to its target aspect itself before sampling." With box1 half outside the frame the clipped mask is a tall sliver (about 680x1299 inside a 1664x2304 image); the crop node then grows that back to a 1:1 target, and the graph's own margin math is computed from the DECLARED box, not the clipped intersection - the bench graph carries a "Return Margin (12% of box)" expression floor(a*0.12+0.5), which is 156px from a 1299 box against 58px from the bench's 480 box - plus context_from_mask_extend_factor 1.10. Compounded, that plausibly swallows the whole frame. The bench works because its overflow is small (x=-130 on a 1280-wide image, ~10%), not because its values are hand-set.
VERIFY BEFORE BELIEVING: re-run the dispatched graph on the bench with the app's real box1 {x:-619,y:556,1299x1299} against a 1664x2304 target and watch the InpaintCrop region. If it swallows the frame, the fix is in the graph (clip the box to the intersection before the margin/size math), not in app code.

START AT: docs/playbooks/add-flow/ui/box-gizmo.md (READ FIRST - it is the contract, and skipping it is what produced the wrong premise above), then the Mpi Box Mask -> InpaintCropImproved leg of comfy_workflows/flow_head_swap.json and its Box Size / Return Margin nodes. App-side capture (js/utils/stepKinds.js, the step `param` bind, headSwapInjector.js) is CLEARED unless the UI-vs-sidecar rounding turns out to matter.

ALSO: Fabio re-exported comfy_workflows/raw/flow_head_swap.json on 2026-09-18 (RemoveBackground now runs AFTER the reference area is picked up). Uncommitted, and the runtime graph still needs the raw->API sync. If the fix lands in the graph, that sync is this card's delivery path, so do both together.
